0004_recipient_role_model_contract: The preceding expand migration backfilled recipient assignments, and the deployed application stopped using the removed owner columns before this contract ran.
0017_dear_northstar: Widening gift price columns from integer to numeric preserves every existing value and remains compatible with integer writes from the previously deployed application.
0019_add_gift_category_colors: The same additive migration keeps the new color column nullable at first, installs a legacy-only BEFORE INSERT trigger so the previously deployed app can keep omitting color during migrate-to-deploy while rows still get their semantic preset or rotated custom color, then backfills every active and soft-deleted category plus a final fallback before enforcing NOT NULL; it does not rebuild rows or touch gift assignments.
0033_add-gift-images: Additive: the only DELETE FROM is inside the cover-mirror trigger on the new gift_image table, which drops a gift's gallery only when a write clears that gift's cover image columns, matching what removing the image meant before galleries existed; no existing row is deleted by the migration itself.
